definitions.gloss: (spirits) cut with hot water; hot-water highball
definitions.explanation: An alcoholic drink, typically {焼酎|しょうちゅう} or whisky, diluted with hot water. Commonly drunk in winter to warm up. The base spirit is usually named: {焼酎|しょうちゅう}の{湯割|ゆわ}り.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湯割|ゆわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: One shochu with hot water, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{湯割|ゆわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}めて→温める：02096_atatameru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: On a cold night, a hot-water highball warms you up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧{芋焼酎|いもじょうちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{湯割|ゆわ}りにして⟦{飲|の}んでいる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: My father drinks sweet-potato shochu cut with hot water every night.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water) + {割|わ}り (dilution). Contrasts with ⟦{水割|みずわ}り→水割り：16023_mizuwari⟧ (cut with cold water) and ⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧ (on the rocks).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湯割|ゆわ}り: shochu cut with hot water
- {湯割|ゆわ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink it as a yuwari
- {湯割|ゆわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make it a yuwari

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水割|みずわ}り→水割り：16023_mizuwari⟧: cut with cold water — same idea but cold
- お{湯割|ゆわ}り: polite form, used in restaurants/bars
- ⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧: on the rocks — no water, just ice
